Approach

I work across the full arc of transformational treatment — supporting preparation, continuity, and the integration that turns an experience into a lasting shift.

01
Prepare
Building readiness

Clients who arrive prepared have better experiences and better outcomes. This phase establishes clear intentions, manages expectations, and builds the psychological and practical groundwork — including early habit foundations — breathwork, reflective practice, and intentional movement — that create a structure clients can build on after treatment.

02
Ground
Grounded presence after treatment

What surfaces in the days immediately after treatment needs somewhere to land. This phase provides that — consistent, grounded presence that helps clients process what emerged, anchor new clarity, and move forward with intention.

03
Integrate
Translating insight

Insights gained during treatment become meaningful when they are actively woven into daily life. This phase supports clients in applying what they experienced — shifting patterns, strengthening relationships, and building habits that reflect who they are becoming.

04
Embody
Continuity that holds

This is the phase where change either takes root or fades. Consistent support in the weeks and months following treatment solidifies new patterns, maintains the trajectory, and ensures the experience becomes a foundation rather than a memory.

Individual Support

Before and after the journey is where the real work lives.

Transformational treatment creates a neurologically distinct window — a period in which the brain is dramatically more receptive to new patterns, habits, and ways of being. But that window begins before you ever walk through the door.

How you prepare shapes the quality of the experience. How you integrate determines how much of it holds.

The habits and patterns established during the post-treatment period become the new neurological default. Those who build strong routines, process what surfaced, and maintain consistent support show significantly better outcomes at 12 months. The experience creates the opening. Structured support is what you build inside it.

How I Work With You

Before treatment, we build the foundation — clear intentions, grounded expectations, and early habit structures designed to carry you through and beyond the experience.

After treatment, we move through that period with structure and intention — stabilizing what surfaced, translating insight into daily decisions, and building the routines that make change neurologically real and lasting.

The four phases — Prepare, Ground, Integrate, Embody — are timed to the biology of how transformation actually holds.

About

I've sat across from people at every stage of change — in boardrooms, classrooms, and some of the most vulnerable moments of their lives.

A career built across industries, cultures, and continents has given me one consistent asset — the ability to connect with people at a level that drives meaningful change. Fifteen years working internationally across sales, business development, and education taught me something that can't be replicated — how to reach people at the level where real change happens. That ability to connect, build trust, and create real movement in people's lives is what makes the difference between support that holds and support that doesn't.

There came a point where external success stopped being the question. Who was I at my best — and was I living from that place? That search led me to transformational experiences that moved something fundamental. Not just what I understood about myself, but what I understood about the depth of change human beings are capable of when they are properly supported.

Certified as an Integration Coach and grounded in years of real-world experience across business, education, and human development — I work with clinics and individuals who are serious about getting the most out of transformational treatment. This work demands more than technique. It requires presence, depth, and a genuine understanding of what change costs and what it makes possible. That understanding is what I bring to every clinic partnership and every individual I work with.
